title: Timers.unenroll has been removed
summary: Node.js removed timers.unenroll (DEP0096: runtime deprecation since v10.0.0, end-of-life since v24.0.0).

constraints: Keep the behavior of the code unchanged; check the replacement's argument and return-value differences.

steps.title: Replace the usage
steps.instructions: Replace each reported use of timers.unenroll with clearTimeout() or clearInterval().

verification.purpose: Run the repository tests when defined.
